description: This file contains JavaScript code for the 'fullpage' plugin of TinyMCE, handling full page editing features such as setting doctype, encoding, styles, and meta tags, as well as UI interactions for the plugin.

classes.name: MCLayer
classes.description: A class representing a layer for menu positioning and display.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the fullpage plugin UI, sets up form elements, color pickers, iframe, and other UI components.

methods.name: setupIframe
methods.description: Loads and parses the current document into the plugin's form fields for editing.

methods.name: updateAction
methods.description: Applies the changes made in the plugin form to the actual document, updating styles, meta tags, and doctype.

methods.name: setMeta
methods.description: Sets or removes a meta tag in the document head.

methods.name: parseStyleElement
methods.description: Parses a style element's innerHTML into rule-data objects.

methods.name: serializeStyleElement
methods.description: Serializes style rule-data objects back into a style block string.

methods.name: getReItem
methods.description: Executes a regex on a string and returns a specific capture group.

methods.name: changedStyleField
methods.description: Placeholder for handling style field changes.

methods.name: addHeadElm
methods.description: Adds a new head element of specified type.

methods.name: updateHeadElm
methods.description: Prepares the UI for updating an existing head element.

methods.name: cancelElementUpdate
methods.description: Cancels the current head element update operation.
